title: FIR Rate Converter
text: Upsample, filter, and downsample input signal, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operation; {Interpolation factor}, {Decimation factor}, {FIR filter coefficients}, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Coefficients} sets the fIR filter coefficients data type fixdt, {Output} sets the data type of output data sample and {Enable ready output port} sets the option to enable ready control signal. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Input data sample scalar | row vector

ports.name: data
ports.summary: Output data sample scalar | row vector

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: Indicates block is ready for new input data scalar

params.name: FIR filter coefficients
params.values: FIR filter coefficients firpm(70, [0 0.28 0.32 1],[1 1 0 0]) (default) | row vector

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients
params.values: FIR filter coefficients data type fixdt(1,16,16) (default)

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of output data sample Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | Inherit via internal rule | fixdt(s,wl,fl)

params.name: Enable ready output port
params.values: Option to enable ready control signal off (default) | on
